fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects a suspicious WinRAR execution in a folder which is not the default installation folder
fields.name: WinRAR Execution in Non-Standard Folder
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (((tgt.process.image.path contains "\\rar.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\winrar.exe") or (tgt.process.displayName in ("Command line RAR","WinRAR"))) and (not (tgt.process.image.path contains "\\UnRAR.exe" or (tgt.process.image.path contains ":\\Program Files (x86)\\WinRAR\\" or tgt.process.image.path contains ":\\Program Files\\WinRAR\\"))) and (not tgt.process.image.path contains ":\\Windows\\Temp\\")))
